title: Patch: Death and Reborn still fire when a dying card is exiled instead of going to the graveyard (Voidwalker, Disintegrex)
notes: R4207000 (superseding R461; amending R1849002, R398, R1852000 and R2564000): a card the state check collects, or a Sacrifice or Tribute takes, that C #50 Voidwalker's aura (base and Radiant) or Stinkyscape #105 Disintegrex's (base and Radiant) exiles instead of sending to its graveyard has still died: its Death fires in R68's order, Reborn returns it from that exile pile at 1 health, destroyed reports it and the destroyed counter counts it, and a Starship Piece fuses; otherwise it stays in exile. A discard, a resolved Spell, a burn, a spent Trap or a mill under Voidwalker, and a plain exile, still fire nothing. The claimed plays are the families classify's stage 2 names against the base build: those two cards, the cards whose games under either aura now diverge, and the Starships the newly fused pieces build. Replays where such a card died are refused as rules_changed (R767000).

player.title: Death and Reborn work under Voidwalker and Disintegrex
changes: A card that dies while Voidwalker or Disintegrex exiles it still fires its Death.
A Reborn Unit that dies that way still comes back with 1 Health.
Those cards count as destroyed, and a Starship Piece exiled that way still fuses.
